newPlatforms.manualReviewReason: KGNU provides an official Music-department routing option but no dedicated submission policy or direct delivery authorization. deduplication.repositoryEvidence: Repository code search was performed for KGNU and kgnu.org before creation. No previous music-submission-agent platform, runtime seed, business-contact or queue record was found.
deduplication.consolidation: The Music-department selector, identified Music Director and public contact form are stored once as one canonical asset-free routing opportunity. Individual DJs, programme pages, event and newsletter forms, phones, social accounts and postal addresses are excluded as duplicate or unauthorized substitutes.

notes: One new free-first KGNU routing opportunity was queued as needs_manual_review. The route is a reCAPTCHA-protected general contact form with a Music department selector, not a direct music-delivery form. No business email was published or inferred, and no form or music was submitted.
